# watchpoint_composite_alert_rule (Data Source)

**Deprecated.** Looks up a single composite alert rule by name within the tenant. Returns the scalar rule fields only; conditions are not included. Composite rules are no longer evaluated by the platform and this data source will be removed in a future release. Express the same combination as an SGL alert rule and use `watchpoint_sgl_alert_rule` instead (Alerting, `/alerting/rules`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_composite_alert_rule" "example" {
  name = "Checkout Path Degraded"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the composite alert rule to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `id` (String) Composite alert rule ID.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
